name: RRSOS PCC Vehicle
description: Terminal command /vehicle: 'spawn' puts a new rover (no gear) a few metres in front of the player; 'upgrade min' gives the nearest rover the first tier of each piece of rover gear it does not have; 'upgrade max' replaces its gear with the top tier of every piece. Terminal only (needs the Commands mod's terminal).

terminalCommands.name: /vehicle
terminalCommands.help: spawn a rover, or fit its gear at the first or top tier
